question: Should OpenClaw permanently reserve a top-level `auth` CLI namespace for model-auth shortcuts, starting with `auth list`, despite the established `models auth` hierarchy?
rationale: The code delegation is straightforward, but choosing a second public command family is a durable CLI compatibility and information-architecture decision that cannot be inferred from tests or contributor intent.

options.title: Keep models auth canonical
options.body: Decline the alias and keep model credential operations under the existing `openclaw models auth` hierarchy.

options.title: Sponsor top-level auth
options.body: Approve the namespace as a deliberate public family and define which existing or future authentication commands belong there.

recommendation.title: Keep models auth canonical
recommendation.body: Decline the alias and keep model credential operations under the existing `openclaw models auth` hierarchy.
